title: LiteLLM Virtual Key Model Alias Incorrect Authorization Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the handling of virtual key model aliases. The issue results from incorrect authorization. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the user.
addtionnal_details:
LiteLLM has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/43049
timeline:
